title: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof
titleEnglish: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof
titleNative: 忍者と殺し屋のふたりぐらし
synopsis: After a series of unfortunate events, young ninja Satoko has found herself sharing a house with the deadly assassin, Konoha. On the run from her village due to a misunderstanding, she’s relying on Konoha’s murderous skills to keep her safe from the ninjas seeking to kill her. But Konoha isn’t the easiest to get along with and is only tolerating Satoko due to her excellent skills at cleaning up messes—both from Konoha’s work and in her home. Somehow, these two will find harmony in their new life together while keeping ninja attackers at bay! So long as they can survive each other, that is. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synonyms: The Academy's Strongest Mob Healer ~ I Reincarnated as a Mob in a Death Game World, Got the Terrible Draw of "Healer" as My Job, and Became the Strongest Using My Knowledge of the Game
synopsis: A famous game romance action RPG "Dungeon Academia". In that famous world of "game to the death," I reincarnated as a mob with the worst job possible: "Healer. " My fate was dying right away... However... I'll use my knowledge from grinding this game for days on end in my previous life to overturn that fate. A reincarnation fantasy, where healing is turned into a weapon to fashion a meteoric rise to the strongest in the world. (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Reluctant Space Commander: From Death Wish to Galactic Hero!
titleRomaji: "Koko wa Makasete Saki ni Ike!" wo Shitai Shinitagari no Nozomanu Uchuu Gekokujou @COMIC
titleEnglish: Reluctant Space Commander: From Death Wish to Galactic Hero!
titleNative: 「ここは任せて先に行け！」をしたい死にたがりの望まぬ宇宙下剋上@COMIC
synopsis: Nao has had it rough. His girlfriend dumped him and ran off with another man, and now his life has lost all meaning. As he contemplates suicide, he catches sight of an advertisement for Space Force—a military force dedicated to protecting the planet from extraterrestrial threats. Finally, a sign that maybe he can do more with his pathetic existence! Without a moment’s hesitation, he joins the force with a simple plan in mind: he’ll sacrifice himself for his comrades after a suave line and be free. Except…Nao is too good at this job! Like, really good—there’s no way he’ll die on his own at this rate! Can Nao find his sweet release, or will he become a hero and have to live with it? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Takou no Koori-hime wo Tasuketara, Otomodachi kara Hajimeru Koto ni Narimashita
titleRomaji: Takou no Koori-hime wo Tasuketara, Otomodachi kara Hajimeru Koto ni Narimashita
titleNative: 他校の氷姫を助けたら、お友達から始める事になりました
synonyms: After Helping the "Ice Princess" from Another School, I Decided to Start as a Friend.
synopsis: Nagi Shinonome, known as the “Ice Princess,” is a beautiful girl with a cold attitude who does not get along with other people. One day, Souta Minori notices her being molested on the train and musters up the courage to step in and save her. The next day she comes up to him again and asks him... "I want you to stay by my side." Can Sota continue to be "just friends” with the "Ice Princess," who melts sweetly only for him? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
